# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2019

**Resolution No. 074**

Supplemental Budget No. 02 — Involving savings from CY 2019 Personal Services P892,724.43, CY 2019 MOOE P758,200, CY 2019 Capital Outlay P150,000, Unappropriated Balance from SB#1 S-2019 P405,329.06, Savings-LDRRM (5 Years) P361,000, Subsidy from [[Provincial Government of Quezon|Provincial Government]] P70,000 — Total P2,637,853.58.

## Summary

Enacted on October 21, 2019, this appropriation ordinance authorizes Supplemental Budget No. 02 for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]], appropriating a total of P2,637,853.58. The supplemental budget draws from multiple funding sources: savings from CY 2019 Personal Services (P892,724.43), CY 2019 MOOE (P758,200), CY 2019 Capital Outlay (P150,000), the unappropriated balance from [[AO-01-S2019|Supplemental Budget No. 01]] (P405,329.06), LDRRM savings accumulated over five years (P361,000), and a subsidy from the Provincial Government (P70,000). The ordinance was introduced by Councilor [[Esperanza A. Tan]]. Note: the original document contains a typographical error in the date, reading "October 21, 209" instead of 2019.

## Key Provisions

- **Supplemental Appropriation.** Authorizes a supplemental budget totaling P2,637,853.58 for CY 2019.
- **Funding Sources.** Draws from six identified sources:
  - CY 2019 Personal Services savings: P892,724.43
  - CY 2019 MOOE savings: P758,200.00
  - CY 2019 Capital Outlay savings: P150,000.00
  - Unappropriated balance from SB#1, S-2019: P405,329.06
  - LDRRM savings (5 years): P361,000.00
  - Subsidy from Provincial Government: P70,000.00
- **Allocation of Funds.** Distributes supplemental funds across various programs, projects, and activities of the municipal government.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
